allocation: fixed slots min(0.25, 1/K); unused slots cash
cash_rule: no positive qualified score or inactive global state means cash
contamination_notes: Frontier-A through Frontier-L development evidence is already observed. Frontier-M activates an older unmeasured Frontier-L reserve; M is repeated development research, not a fresh holdout. 2023-2024 is SPENT_DO_NOT_MUTATE and excluded.
cost_hypothesis: weekly rebalance, sparse top-five fixed slots, cash on absent state, and persistent eligibility exits should limit unnecessary turnover; fixed cost ladder is evaluated without post-result retuning
failure_mode: the gate merely times generic trend or entropy disagreement has no stable relation to opportunity density
falsifier: hold risk when entropy disagreement is below its trailing median
primitive: Quantiacs daily OHLCV and historical is_liquid only
rebalance: Mondays; persistent immediate strict-liquidity loss exits
selection: positive scores, top-K, deterministic label tie breaks
selection_objective: minimum research/dev Sharpe across 0.04/0.08/0.12 ATR cost; then worst DD, lower turnover, id
source_notes: Activates a Frontier-L reserve that was preregistered before Frontier-L returns. Frontier-L measured evidence informed only the decision to open a separate reserve campaign, not this hypothesis or its grid.
stop_rule: freeze if matched ablation or destructive falsifier matches/beats canonical parent, or if every valid base cell is below fixed 1.0 development floor; do not invert, retune or substitute after observing failure
thesis: Cross-sectional disagreement in residual sequence entropy defines opportunity density: hold positive residual-trend names only when entropy disagreement is unusually high and otherwise remain in cash.
timing: completed daily residual returns; Monday entropy disagreement compared only with prior Monday states
universe: historical is_liquid == 1 for signal state and weights; no hand-picked symbols
validation: 2023-2024 is SPENT_DO_NOT_MUTATE and excluded from Frontier-M; 2025+ diagnostic/live evidence never drives mutation
